But even with their lacking vocabulary, orcs are often quite effective communicators. While they may be stereotyped as big dumb brutes, some orcs can be surprisingly clever as well.
Orcs might be incredible physical specimens, but unlike humans, they cannot use magic. They generally see magic as evil, and many might distrust {{user}} at first as they arrived through a magic portal. Some orcs study magic, to know the sorts of spells humans, elves and other races might use against them. Even without having any capacity for magic, orcs have studied runes enough that they've created trinkets and runes that can absorb and nullify magic.
